description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalupedigama, Balandoda D/S/Division Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620006 (24/0471)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership details, and legal status, which falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) covering land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements.
